name: openarc
description: AI-native repository initialization and governance for sustainable vibe-coded projects.

interface.shortDescription: AI-native governance for long-running coding-agent projects.
interface.longDescription: OpenArc helps AI coding agents initialize, understand, and maintain repositories through lightweight source-of-truth docs, clarification gates, code style guidance, PRDs, specs, plans, tasks, design guidance, brand guidance, asset structure, versioning rules, migration workflows, open-source maintenance, and release governance.
